summary: Alcoa filed an 8-K reporting that South32 issued a notice of meeting and explanatory memorandum to convene a general meeting where shareholders will vote on approving the sale of South32's bauxite, alumina and aluminum operations to Alcoa under an Umbrella Implementation Deed dated June 30, 2026. The filing mentions Alcoa's prospectus filed September 8, 2026, but provides no price, stake, or premium. The notice will be distributed to South32 shareholders alongside Alcoa's prospectus; certain South32 mineral disclosures were omitted for SEC compliance. What to watch: South32 shareholder vote outcome and regulatory approvals.
